_meta.purpose: Template codes that must NEVER be shown as players in the DPS overlay. When a 1B 56 packet maps a runtime entity ID to one of these template codes, DataRepository's mob-name lookup returns a name, and DpsCalculator's 'known-mob guard' filters the entity out of the player list. This catches boss invisible-summon carriers (N_Invisible_Summon_*) that cast player-range skill codes and would otherwise trigger the 'presumed player' fallback.
